general.note: Home of “Wayne Med-Direct,” a real early-assurance BS/MD-style pathway into Wayne State University School of Medicine (~10 seats/yr; posted eligibility: 3.5 GPA, 1310 SAT/28 ACT). Detroit campus sits directly next to the Detroit Medical Center, a large hospital system, giving genuinely strong clinical/shadowing access. Very low overall 4-year grad rate reflects the broader (commuter-heavy) student body, not the honors/pathway track specifically — real trade-off, not a data error.
general.medNote: The hospital-adjacency and Med-Direct pathway are the draw; confirm the current cycle’s deadline directly with med-direct@wayne.edu — the program’s own page reads a bit stale.
